notes.title: SUPER NANARU UPDATE (MARCH 25)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Check out what has been updated in SUPER NANARU today(Friday, March 25)!

[list]
[*] Addressed graphic issues found in some of the stages.
[*] Modified special effects of some characters.
[*] Improved game stability.
[/list]
Thank you all for playing SUPER NANARU, and for visiting our Community Hub.
We'll do our best to meet your expectations.
